rule: Structural-only fidelity ≠ PASS for Phase3 unlock

ablation.method: Remove research-data leaves; signal overlap with baseline must drop >=40%

random_proxy.method: Shuffle research series in time (break alignment); expectancy/signal must degrade

event_order_destroy.method: Permute event_sequence step order / destroy lead→lag order

regime_veto.method: Force regime_ok=0; entries must go to zero (fail-closed)

behavioral_independence.method: Pairwise fingerprint/data/AST similarity; <3 high dims vs other probes

scoring.causal_pass_needs: >=4 of 5 causal tests pass AND uses_new_data AND not_ohlc_template
